facts.fact: The 2026 finance law (Loi de Finances n° 2025-987 of 19 December 2025) appropriates FCFA 500,000,000 from domestic revenue under section 323, Ministry of the Interior and Security, for activity 78016001649, supporting the process of modernising civil status/ONECI; the same amount as proposed, and identical in all three years per the record.
facts.system: processus de modernisation de l'Etat civil/ONECI (budget activity 78016001649)

facts.fact: The 2026 finance law places the civil status modernisation line with the Ministry of the Interior and Security (section 323), for ONECI.
facts.system: processus de modernisation de l'Etat civil/ONECI (budget activity 78016001649)

note: A budget line, not a named information system: the facts are attached to the line's own label, 'modernisation de l'Etat civil/ONECI', which names no software and does not say what the money buys. The parent should weigh whether it counts as a domestic line for the civil registration system.
